core/ — shared code, knows no project

svg.text: uses (calls what the file defines); colour = the folder of the user
apps.js lists a part's files (core/parts.js loads them)

Thick arrow from a page into core/, library/ or the CDN: its arrows to the files named on it (* a tag only). Pages have a dark frame; under each name its size on disk. Hover an arrow for its two files. Not drawn: *.md (docs), index.html (directory listings), house/archon/ (the drawings house.js comes from).
